scientific_integrity: Originality is assessed against specific inspected sources with explicit priority risk; the exact three-dimensional support, support volume and sharp determinant optimizer are analytic claims. Independent external audit has not occurred.
scientific_limitations: Exact result only for a stationary, positive-rate binary input and contraction rates gamma,2gamma,3gamma. Support describes topological accessibility, not density regularity; the general telegraph filter covariance identity and planar supports have earlier literature. The unique determinant optimum is conditional on the fixed spectral ratio.
title: Exact three-mode support and a unique covariance-volume resonance in dichotomous linear dynamics
